# Project Git & Contribution Rules

Every time code changes are to be committed and pushed in this repository:
1. Always work and commit on the branch: **`chimataraghuram-dev`**.
2. Push all commits to `origin/chimataraghuram-dev`.
3. Every commit message MUST include the following co-authors at the end of the commit body:

```
Co-authored-by: bchakradharreddy <bchakradharreddy@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Ramesh7075 <Ramesh7075@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: shalemshalem250-bot <shalemshalem250-bot@users.noreply.github.com>
```

4. **PR & Badge Rule**:
   - Always create a **Pull Request (PR)** from `chimataraghuram-dev` into `main` for every set of changes (never push straight to main directly).
   - Merge the PR so GitHub registers the Pull Request activity and awards GitHub PR contribution badges / stats (e.g. Pull Shark badge).
   - Always provide the direct PR creation / comparison link in chat after pushing.
